question: What will happen if we cover a burning candle with a glass jar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**It will stop burning**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A candle requires oxygen to sustain combustion. When you cover it with a glass jar, the available oxygen inside the jar will be consumed by the flame.
 
• As the candle burns, it uses up oxygen and produces carbon dioxide and water vapor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The principles of combustion and the behavior of gases:
 
• **Depletion of Oxygen**:
 
 
• A candle requires oxygen to sustain combustion. When you cover it with a glass jar, the available oxygen inside the jar will be consumed by the flame.
 
• As the candle burns, it uses up oxygen and produces carbon dioxide and water vapor.
 
 
 
• .**Flame Extinguishing:**
 
 
• Once the oxygen level drops below a certain threshold, the flame will extinguish. This typically occurs within a few minutes, depending on the size of the candle and the jar.
 
 
 
• **Formation of Water Vapor**
 
 
• The heat from the candle will cause water vapor to form as the wax burns. This vapor will condense on the inner surface of the jar as it cools down
 
 
 
• **Reduced Temperature**:
 
 
• Once the flame goes out, the temperature inside the jar will decrease as there is no longer a source of heat
 
 
 
• **Vacuum Effect (if covered tightly):**
 
 
• If the jar is tightly sealed, a slight vacuum effect may occur as the candle goes out and the air cools, leading to a slight decrease in pressure inside the jar.
